tooltips.name: Order number. Auto-generated by the intake flow, or enter manually.
tooltips.isCorporate: Copied from the customer. Corporate orders can be issued a VAT invoice.
tooltips.paymentStatus: Whether the order has been paid. Independent of the work status — an order can be paid before it is done, or done on credit.
tooltips.driver: Who brings the car in. A client contact — does not affect wages.
tooltips.worksTotal: Sum of the order's work amounts — the wage cost of this order.
tooltips.startedAt: Stamped automatically when the order goes In Progress.
tooltips.finishedAt: Stamped automatically when the order is Completed.
tooltips.invoiceSentAt: When the invoice was sent to the customer.
tooltips.linesHtml: Filled by the system for printed documents — always Latvian, whatever the user's language.
tooltips.paymentMethodText: Filled by the system for printed documents — always Latvian, whatever the user's language.
tooltips.pvnEnabled: Whether the printed invoice/receipt breaks out PVN 21%. When off, the document shows only the total without a VAT split.
tooltips.readyNotifiedAt: Stamped once when the order became Completed and the customer was notified (or the attempt was recorded). Prevents a second message.
tooltips.post: Bay number the booking holds. Set automatically for online bookings.
tooltips.plannedMinutes: How long the order occupies a bay: base service + add-ons. Filled automatically.
tooltips.noShow: The customer did not arrive for the reservation. The slot is released.
tooltips.fiscalStatus: Not Required = paid by bank transfer on an invoice. Pending = cash or card sale not yet matched to a receipt of the certified cash register. Registered = receipt data entered. Receipt = a registered receipt (kvits) was issued under the exceptions of Cabinet Regulation 96. This CRM is NOT a cash register: it only keeps the reference.
tooltips.fiscalReceiptSeries: Series of the document, if the register prints one (a registered receipt has a two-letter series).
tooltips.fiscalReceiptNo: The document number printed by the certified cash register (kases sistema / device). Copied, never generated here.
tooltips.fiscalDeviceId: Unique ID of the fiscal memory module or the register's chassis number, as on its receipt.
tooltips.fiscalIntegrationId: The ID under which this CRM is declared as an integrated information system in the register's technical passport.
tooltips.fiscalPrintedAt: Date and time on the register's document.
tooltips.fiscalHash: SHA-1 checksum printed on the register's document, copied as is (optional).
tooltips.subscription: Pay this wash from the customer's subscription. The wash is spent when the order is Completed and given back if it is cancelled; the order price becomes 0 EUR (the money was taken when the subscription was sold).

messages.emailInvoiceConfirm: Generate the invoice PDF and email it to the customer?
